claude_generation_contract.raw_response_policy: When ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is available, the generator writes raw-claude-response.json verbatim and stores the exact SVG strings Claude returned. Validators may reject output but must not rewrite it.
claude_generation_contract.regeneration_policy: A failed SVG or manifest check is returned to Claude as a failure report for regeneration; the product renderer never patches labels, layout, content, or SVG markup after Claude generation.

validation_scope: unsafe SVG tag and event-handler rejection
